name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.6.

Stays findable after an update: ASVA now makes sure it keeps its Start-menu shortcut every time it opens, so after an update you can always search "ASVA" and open the app, instead of accidentally reopening the old setup file.

Search a customer when recording a payment: the Add-a-payment screen now lets you type a name to find the customer instantly, instead of scrolling a long list.

Proper publisher name: ASVA now shows "Almmatix" as the publisher in Windows, like other trusted apps.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
